name: Arbiter
description: Fast first-pass claim verification. Searches the open web, returns supported / contradicted / insufficient with the source URLs that justify the verdict. Cites sources from live search — does not fetch or hash page content. Refuses rather than guessing when search returns nothing.

pricing.free_tier: First verify per seat is free

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Verify a factual claim. Searches the open web and returns supported / contradicted / insufficient with the source URLs. Does not fetch pages — for page-level proof use a fetcher like Ground.

tools.name: research
tools.description: Answer a factual question grounded in live web sources.

guarantee: If search returns nothing usable, the service refuses. It does not answer from model memory.
